M1.description: No active detail statistic or bar exists; scored matched repeats and comparator arms are also absent.

M2.description: Residual noise can be computed diagnostically, but the registered matched-information verdict cannot.

M3.description: Artifact counts without a licensed detail/matched-presentation arm cannot support the competitive claim.

M4.description: Flatness is computable diagnostically, but its detail-preserving comparator verdict is blocked.

M5.description: No scored dense/sparse repeat unit exists, and failure coverage needs a licensed detail test.

M6.description: The rail census is executable, but the registered capture set has fewer than 10,000 recoverable samples and the full axis includes detail retention and comparators.

M8.description: The v1.4 source-hull invariant needs neither detail nor a comparator and may use the development-only flat slide. **Checker commissioned and result read at `76b3d9cc`: FAIL, M8-R `1.030569%` and M8-O `1.326144%` against a bar of exactly `0.0000%`.** This is the only axis in the program with a produced-and-read score.

M9.description: Repeat calibration captures are absent and the shipping product emits no admissible acuity/variance certificate.

M10.description: No scored geometric-truth capture or compatible depth product exists. The tilted slide is development-only.

M11.description: A quiet host is additionally required; native-decode timing alone is a diagnostic, not the registered competitive verdict.

M12.description: Hashes and process-tree RSS need no detail, comparator or holdout. Existing out-of-protocol evidence diagnoses fixed-worker determinism as holding and cross-worker scaling invariance as failing, but the registered N/worker matrix still requires the reserved quiet host.

M1.reason: The axis is the missing sharpening-safe information instrument itself.

M2.reason: Its own success bar is eta and a noise ratio; the future-M1 mode qualifier is rule-4 propagation.

M3.reason: Its own bar is halo, veil, edge width, and local coherence; replacement M1 appears only as an added blur control.

M4.reason: Its own bar is flat patchwork and ghost rate; replacement M1 appears only in the control paragraph.

M5.reason: Coverage is defined by source-band coherence and focus margin, so a detail-bearing test is part of the axis.

M6.reason: Highlight-detail retention is an explicit member of the success bar.

M7.reason: The source readiness row assigns no blocker (a); the bar is external-target colour fidelity.

M8.reason: The source readiness row assigns no blocker (a); the bar is an exact source-support invariant.

M9.reason: Empirical acuity truth is explicitly the future independently commissioned M1 condition.

M10.reason: The source readiness row assigns no blocker (a); the bar uses external geometric truth.

M11.reason: Its numeric bar is elapsed time; replacement-M1 qualification enters through comparator quality qualification.

M12.reason: The source readiness row assigns no blocker (a); the bar is memory and reproducibility.

S2.name: rule 4 narrowed to matched output
S2.rule: Comparator eligibility requires the same hashed common input; native-size 16-bit linear output; frozen ICC, tone-ramp, geometry, crop, dimensions, and bit depth; and no post-processing. It does not require replacement-M1 or a 98% information score. This substitutes matched output for M2's comparator-information qualification while leaving M5, M6, and M9 intrinsic detail requirements intact.
